# JusRental — Rental Property Platform for Bangalore

## About
JusRental is a zero-brokerage rental property platform focused on North Bangalore.
We connect property owners directly with verified tenants.

## Website Structure
- / — Homepage with property showcase, area explorer, testimonials
- /properties — Browse verified rental properties with filters
- /properties/[id] — Individual property detail page
- /list-property — Property owners can list their rental property
- /rent-estimator — Estimate rental rates by area and BHK
- /blog — Rental tips, market trends, neighbourhood guides
- /blog/[slug] — Individual blog post
- /contact — Contact form and WhatsApp
- /book-visit — Schedule a property visit
- /nri-services — Services for Non-Resident Indians
- /rental-agreement — Rental agreement information

## Key Features
- 100% verified property listings
- Zero brokerage for tenants
- WhatsApp-first communication
- NRI-friendly services
- Real-time availability updates

## Coverage Areas
North Bangalore: Hennur, Hebbal, Yelahanka, Thanisandra, Devanahalli, Horamavu
